Done. This one is worth explaining, because the link was never broken. Every phone number on the site is a `tel:` link, which is what a phone number has to be: on a phone it opens the dialler, and that is how most people reach the practice. On a desktop the browser hands `tel:` to Windows, and if nothing on that machine is registered to answer phone links, Windows does nothing at all — no page, no error, no dialler. From your side that is indistinguishable from a dead button, and you were right to file it. We checked it properly rather than guessing: on the published pages nothing intercepts or cancels the click, so the link itself is sound. What was missing was an answer. Clicking a phone number on a computer now copies it to your clipboard and shows a short “Copied (281) 769-8878” confirmation next to the button, so the click always does something you can see. On a phone nothing changed — it still dials. The number is unchanged everywhere: (281) 769-8878. Live on staging.masonparkdental.com, checked in Chrome at your 2560 x 1305 window.
